<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 22:27">Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXII, 27</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:17">Ber. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ולימא … ותו לא</he> but let him say this verse (<cite ref="Numbers 24:9">Num. XXIV, 9</cite>), and no more.

<cite ref="Gittin 56a:18">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ותו אי מלכא אנא וכ׳</he> and furthermore, if I am a king, why didst thou not come ere this? <cite ref="Nedarim 16a:6">Ned. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ואמר אכילנא אכילנא ותו שבועה וכ׳</he> and he said, I will eat, I will eat, and added, I swear &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 16a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ותו אמר וכ׳</he> and in addition thereto he said &c.
